parts.text: How many unused leave days can I carry over into next year, and until when?

eval_cases.context:
[01-leave-policy.md#annual-leave-entitlement] Leave policy: Annual leave entitlement
| Office | Annual leave (working days) | Extra days after 5 years |
|---|---|---|
| Istanbul | 20 | +2 |
| Ankara | 20 | +2 |
| Berlin | 28 | +1 |

Entitlement is pro-rated in your first calendar year. Your current balance is always in the HRIS; the
Workplace Assistant reads it for you.

[01-leave-policy.md#requesting-leave] Leave policy: Requesting leave
- Request leave in the HRIS (or ask the Workplace Assistant to submit it for you).
- Give at least **3 working days' notice** for requests of 1–2 days, and **2 weeks' notice** for longer requests.
- Your **team lead approves** your request. The HRIS routes it automatically based on your team.
- A request is `PENDING` until approved. Pending days count against your balance.
- Half days are allowed. Use leave type `ANNUAL_HALF_DAY`.

[01-leave-policy.md#carry-over] Leave policy: Carry-over
You can carry up to **5 unused days** into the next year. Carried-over days expire on **31 March**.

[01-leave-policy.md#sick-leave] Leave policy: Sick leave
Tell your team lead on the first day. From the third consecutive day you need a doctor's note uploaded to
the HRIS. Sick leave does not reduce your annual leave balance.

[01-leave-policy.md#parental-leave] Leave policy: Parental leave
Parental leave follows local law in each office, plus 4 extra paid weeks from Kuzey Labs for every parent.
Talk to your People Partner at least 8 weeks before the planned start.

[01-leave-policy.md#public-holidays] Leave policy: Public holidays
Public holidays depend on your **office**, not on where you happen to be working.

### Istanbul and Ankara (2026)

- 1 January — New Year's Day
- 23 April — National Sovereignty and Children's Day
- 1 May — Labour and Solidarity Day
- 19 May — Commemoration of Atatürk, Youth and Sports Day
- 15 July — Democracy and National Unity Day
- 30 August — Victory Day
- 29 October — Republic Day (28 October afternoon is a half day)
- Ramadan Feast and Feast of Sacrifice: dates are announced in the HRIS each year

### Berlin (2026)

- 1 January, Good Friday, Easter Monday, 1 May, Ascension Day, Whit Monday
- 3 October — Day of German Unity
- 25 and 26 December

[01-leave-policy.md#platform-team-on-call] Leave policy: Platform team on-call
Platform team members who are on call during a requested leave day must find a swap before the team lead
approves the request. The on-call rota is in the platform team's calendar.

[02-remote-work.md#hybrid-schedule] Remote and hybrid work: Hybrid schedule
Kuzey Labs is hybrid. Each office has two **anchor days** when teams are expected in the office:

| Office | Anchor days |
|---|---|
| Istanbul | Tuesday and Thursday |
| Ankara | Monday and Wednesday |
| Berlin | Tuesday and Wednesday |

Outside anchor days you choose where you work. Agree exceptions with your team lead.

[02-remote-work.md#working-from-another-country] Remote and hybrid work: Working from another country
You can work from another country for up to **20 working days per calendar year**. Request it in the HRIS
at least 2 weeks in advance so the People team can check tax and visa rules. Working from abroad is not
leave and does not reduce your leave balance.

[02-remote-work.md#home-office-budget] Remote and hybrid work: Home office budget
New joiners get a one-time home office budget of **EUR 600** (or the TRY equivalent) for a chair, desk or
monitor. Submit receipts as an expense within 90 days of your start date.

[02-remote-work.md#core-hours] Remote and hybrid work: Core hours
Core collaboration hours are **10:00–16:00 in your office's time zone**. Outside core hours, nobody should
expect an immediate reply.

[03-it-equipment-and-support.md#laptops] IT equipment and support: Laptops
- Engineers get a laptop refresh every **3 years**; everyone else every **4 years**.
- Report a lost or stolen laptop **immediately** as a P1 ticket and tell Security.
- Do not install unapproved software. The approved list is in the IT portal.

[03-it-equipment-and-support.md#opening-an-it-ticket] IT equipment and support: Opening an IT ticket
Open tickets through the IT desk (or ask the Workplace Assistant). Include what you were doing, what you
expected and what happened. Pick a category: `HARDWARE`, `SOFTWARE`, `ACCESS`, `NETWORK` or `OTHER`.

[03-it-equipment-and-support.md#priorities-and-response-times] IT equipment and support: Priorities and response times
| Priority | Meaning | First response |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | You cannot work at all, or a security incident | 30 minutes |
| P2 | A major part of your work is blocked | 4 working hours |
| P3 | Something is broken but there is a workaround | 1 working day |
| P4 | A request or question | 3 working days |

[03-it-equipment-and-support.md#passwords-and-access] IT equipment and support: Passwords and access
- Reset your SSO password yourself at the SSO portal. The IT desk never asks for your password.
- Access to production systems needs your team lead's approval in the ticket (`ACCESS` category).
- VPN is only needed for the legacy finance systems. Everything else uses SSO and device trust.

[03-it-equipment-and-support.md#peripherals] IT equipment and support: Peripherals
Every office has a stock of keyboards, mice, headsets and USB-C adapters. Ask the IT desk with a P4
ticket. Monitors for home offices are covered by the home office budget, not by IT.

[04-expenses-and-travel.md#submitting-expenses] Expenses and travel: Submitting expenses
Submit expenses within **30 days** with a receipt. Expenses under EUR 50 need no pre-approval. Anything
above EUR 50 needs your team lead's approval before you spend it.

[04-expenses-and-travel.md#business-travel] Expenses and travel: Business travel
- Book travel through the travel portal so we know where you are.
- Economy class for flights under 6 hours; premium economy for longer flights.
- Hotels: up to EUR 160 per night in Berlin and TRY 6,000 per night in Istanbul or Ankara.

[04-expenses-and-travel.md#per-diem] Expenses and travel: Per diem
| Destination | Daily allowance |
|---|---|
| Turkey | TRY 1,500 |
| EU | EUR 55 |
| Rest of world | EUR 70 |

[04-expenses-and-travel.md#learning-budget] Expenses and travel: Learning budget
Every employee has a yearly learning budget of **EUR 1,000** for courses, books and conferences.
Conference travel counts towards the budget.

[05-compensation-and-confidentiality.md#how-pay-works] Compensation and confidentiality: How pay works
- Pay is reviewed once a year, in **March**. Changes take effect on 1 April.
- Every role has a **level** (L1–L7) and every level has a published **salary band** per office.
- Bands are public inside Kuzey Labs. Ask your People Partner if you cannot find them.

[05-compensation-and-confidentiality.md#individual-compensation-is-confidential] Compensation and confidentiality: Individual compensation is confidential
An individual's salary, bonus or equity is **confidential**. Only the employee, their manager and the People
team can see it.

- Do not ask colleagues to share their pay data with you, and do not share other people's.
- **The Workplace Assistant does not disclose any individual's compensation**, including your own. For your
  own pay, use the payroll portal or talk to your People Partner.
- The Workplace Assistant is not connected to payroll. Questions about payslips go to payroll@kuzeylabs.example.

[05-compensation-and-confidentiality.md#who-to-contact] Compensation and confidentiality: Who to contact
| Topic | Contact |
|---|---|
| Your own salary, bonus or equity | Your People Partner |
| Payslips and tax forms | payroll@kuzeylabs.example |
| Salary bands | The internal levels page, or your People Partner |

[06-onboarding-and-people.md#your-first-week] Onboarding and people: Your first week
- Day 1: laptop handover, SSO setup and a welcome lunch with your team.
- Day 2–3: security training (mandatory, about 2 hours) and the engineering or business onboarding track.
- Day 5: first 1:1 with your team lead.

[06-onboarding-and-people.md#teams] Onboarding and people: Teams
| Team | What they do | Offices |
|---|---|---|
| Platform | Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, on-call | Istanbul, Berlin |
| Data | Analytics, data pipelines, ML | Ankara |
| Product | Product management and design | Istanbul |
| IT Desk | Laptops, access, internal tools | Istanbul |
| People | HR, People Partners, recruiting | Istanbul |
| Sales | Customers in DACH and Turkey | Berlin, Istanbul |

[06-onboarding-and-people.md#people-partners] Onboarding and people: People Partners
Every team has a People Partner for questions about leave, growth, pay and conflicts. You can find yours
in your HRIS profile.

[06-onboarding-and-people.md#feedback-and-growth] Onboarding and people: Feedback and growth
Kuzey Labs runs growth conversations twice a year, in **March** and **September**. Promotions are decided
in March together with pay reviews.

- 19 May — Commemoration of Atatürk, Youth and Sports Day
- 15 July — Democracy and National Unity Day
- 30 August — Victory Day
- 29 October — Republic Day (28 October afternoon is a half day)
- Ramadan Feast and Feast of Sacrifice: dates are announced in the HRIS each year

### Berlin (2026)

- 1 January, Good Friday, Easter Monday, 1 May, Ascension Day, Whit Monday
- 3 October — Day of German Unity
- 25 and 26 December

[01-leave-policy.md#platform-team-on-call] Leave policy: Platform team on-call
Platform team members who are on call during a requested leave day must find a swap before the team lead
approves the request. The on-call rota is in the platform team's calendar.

[02-remote-work.md#hybrid-schedule] Remote and hybrid work: Hybrid schedule
Kuzey Labs is hybrid. Each office has two **anchor days** when teams are expected in the office:

| Office | Anchor days |
|---|---|
| Istanbul | Tuesday and Thursday |
| Ankara | Monday and Wednesday |
| Berlin | Tuesday and Wednesday |

Outside anchor days you choose where you work. Agree exceptions with your team lead.

[02-remote-work.md#working-from-another-country] Remote and hybrid work: Working from another country
You can work from another country for up to **20 working days per calendar year**. Request it in the HRIS
at least 2 weeks in advance so the People team can check tax and visa rules. Working from abroad is not
leave and does not reduce your leave balance.

[02-remote-work.md#home-office-budget] Remote and hybrid work: Home office budget
New joiners get a one-time home office budget of **EUR 600** (or the TRY equivalent) for a chair, desk or
monitor. Submit receipts as an expense within 90 days of your start date.

[02-remote-work.md#core-hours] Remote and hybrid work: Core hours
Core collaboration hours are **10:00–16:00 in your office's time zone**. Outside core hours, nobody should
expect an immediate reply.

[03-it-equipment-and-support.md#laptops] IT equipment and support: Laptops
- Engineers get a laptop refresh every **3 years**; everyone else every **4 years**.
- Report a lost or stolen laptop **immediately** as a P1 ticket and tell Security.
- Do not install unapproved software. The approved list is in the IT portal.

[03-it-equipment-and-support.md#opening-an-it-ticket] IT equipment and support: Opening an IT ticket
Open tickets through the IT desk (or ask the Workplace Assistant). Include what you were doing, what you
expected and what happened. Pick a category: `HARDWARE`, `SOFTWARE`, `ACCESS`, `NETWORK` or `OTHER`.

[03-it-equipment-and-support.md#priorities-and-response-times] IT equipment and support: Priorities and response times
| Priority | Meaning | First response |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | You cannot work at all, or a security incident | 30 minutes |
| P2 | A major part of your work is blocked | 4 working hours |
| P3 | Something is broken but there is a workaround | 1 working day |
| P4 | A request or question | 3 working days |

[03-it-equipment-and-support.md#passwords-and-access] IT equipment and support: Passwords and access
- Reset your SSO password yourself at the SSO portal. The IT desk never asks for your password.
- Access to production systems needs your team lead's approval in the ticket (`ACCESS` category).
- VPN is only needed for the legacy finance systems. Everything else uses SSO and device trust.

[03-it-equipment-and-support.md#peripherals] IT equipment and support: Peripherals
Every office has a stock of keyboards, mice, headsets and USB-C adapters. Ask the IT desk with a P4
ticket. Monitors for home offices are covered by the home office budget, not by IT.

[04-expenses-and-travel.md#submitting-expenses] Expenses and travel: Submitting expenses
Submit expenses within **30 days** with a receipt. Expenses under EUR 50 need no pre-approval. Anything
above EUR 50 needs your team lead's approval before you spend it.

[04-expenses-and-travel.md#business-travel] Expenses and travel: Business travel
- Book travel through the travel portal so we know where you are.
- Economy class for flights under 6 hours; premium economy for longer flights.
- Hotels: up to EUR 160 per night in Berlin and TRY 6,000 per night in Istanbul or Ankara.

[04-expenses-and-travel.md#per-diem] Expenses and travel: Per diem
| Destination | Daily allowance |
|---|---|
| Turkey | TRY 1,500 |
| EU | EUR 55 |
| Rest of world | EUR 70 |

[04-expenses-and-travel.md#learning-budget] Expenses and travel: Learning budget
Every employee has a yearly learning budget of **EUR 1,000** for courses, books and conferences.
Conference travel counts towards the budget.

[05-compensation-and-confidentiality.md#how-pay-works] Compensation and confidentiality: How pay works
- Pay is reviewed once a year, in **March**. Changes take effect on 1 April.
- Every role has a **level** (L1–L7) and every level has a published **salary band** per office.
- Bands are public inside Kuzey Labs. Ask your People Partner if you cannot find them.

[05-compensation-and-confidentiality.md#individual-compensation-is-confidential] Compensation and confidentiality: Individual compensation is confidential
An individual's salary, bonus or equity is **confidential**. Only the employee, their manager and the People
team can see it.

- Do not ask colleagues to share their pay data with you, and do not share other people's.
- **The Workplace Assistant does not disclose any individual's compensation**, including your own. For your
  own pay, use the payroll portal or talk to your People Partner.
- The Workplace Assistant is not connected to payroll. Questions about payslips go to payroll@kuzeylabs.example.

[05-compensation-and-confidentiality.md#who-to-contact] Compensation and confidentiality: Who to contact
| Topic | Contact |
|---|---|
| Your own salary, bonus or equity | Your People Partner |
| Payslips and tax forms | payroll@kuzeylabs.example |
| Salary bands | The internal levels page, or your People Partner |

[06-onboarding-and-people.md#your-first-week] Onboarding and people: Your first week
- Day 1: laptop handover, SSO setup and a welcome lunch with your team.
- Day 2–3: security training (mandatory, about 2 hours) and the engineering or business onboarding track.
- Day 5: first 1:1 with your team lead.

[06-onboarding-and-people.md#teams] Onboarding and people: Teams
| Team | What they do | Offices |
|---|---|---|
| Platform | Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, on-call | Istanbul, Berlin |
| Data | Analytics, data pipelines, ML | Ankara |
| Product | Product management and design | Istanbul |
| IT Desk | Laptops, access, internal tools | Istanbul |
| People | HR, People Partners, recruiting | Istanbul |
| Sales | Customers in DACH and Turkey | Berlin, Istanbul |

[06-onboarding-and-people.md#people-partners] Onboarding and people: People Partners
Every team has a People Partner for questions about leave, growth, pay and conflicts. You can find yours
in your HRIS profile.

[06-onboarding-and-people.md#feedback-and-growth] Onboarding and people: Feedback and growth
Kuzey Labs runs growth conversations twice a year, in **March** and **September**. Promotions are decided
in March together with pay reviews.

[01-leave-policy.md#annual-leave-entitlement] Leave policy: Annual leave entitlement
| Office | Annual leave (working days) | Extra days after 5 years |
|---|---|---|
| Istanbul | 20 | +2 |
| Ankara | 20 | +2 |
| Berlin | 28 | +1 |

Entitlement is pro-rated in your first calendar year. Your current balance is always in the HRIS; the
Workplace Assistant reads it for you.

[01-leave-policy.md#requesting-leave] Leave policy: Requesting leave
- Request leave in the HRIS (or ask the Workplace Assistant to submit it for you).
- Give at least **3 working days' notice** for requests of 1–2 days, and **2 weeks' notice** for longer requests.
- Your **team lead approves** your request. The HRIS routes it automatically based on your team.
- A request is `PENDING` until approved. Pending days count against your balance.
- Half days are allowed. Use leave type `ANNUAL_HALF_DAY`.

[01-leave-policy.md#carry-over] Leave policy: Carry-over
You can carry up to **5 unused days** into the next year. Carried-over days expire on **31 March**.

[01-leave-policy.md#sick-leave] Leave policy: Sick leave
Tell your team lead on the first day. From the third consecutive day you need a doctor's note uploaded to
the HRIS. Sick leave does not reduce your annual leave balance.

[01-leave-policy.md#parental-leave] Leave policy: Parental leave
Parental leave follows local law in each office, plus 4 extra paid weeks from Kuzey Labs for every parent.
Talk to your People Partner at least 8 weeks before the planned start.

[01-leave-policy.md#public-holidays] Leave policy: Public holidays
Public holidays depend on your **office**, not on where you happen to be working.
